name: Nikki Budzinski
desc: American politician and labor union leader (born 1977)
summary: Nicole Jai Budzinski ( bəd-ZIN-skee;  pol. /bud͡ʑiɲski/) (born March 11, 1977) is an American trade unionist and politician. She has served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 13th congressional district since 2023, and is a member of the Democratic Party.
